notes.title: Steam Multiplayer Support and More!
notes.notes:
A major update just dropped for the Bomberrage demo with tons of new content and improvements!

[b][h2]🎮 Steam Multiplayer is NOW LIVE! 🎮[/h2][/b]
[b]Simply invite or join your friends through Steam Friends to play together![/b]

[b]⚡️ Performance[/b]
• Game runs much smoother with massive performance improvements
• Online matches are now more stable with less lag

[b]🎨 New Content[/b]
• Finished 4 skins for each character with skins unlock mechanic:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517539/c5537b988e53f44b1412c59067f0fc353b43dd86.jpg[/img]

• Added [b]Play Area Surrounder[/b] mod on medium difficulty surrounding the play area with walls over time:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517539/c5ec8d91e999353e92a9512cfe2c6cc65e4f7443.gif[/img]

• Added [b]Bomb Storm[/b] mod on hard difficulty massively spawning bombs:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517539/d3cf5f27d4744cc068a47c878676a4c3f32d8a9d.gif[/img]

• New Bastet bomb:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517539/825c8f0e16ed87a27dd9e0fb7eed39005d6e7497.png[/img]

• Progression System has been updated with new star mesh:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517539/c24cf996ef360b6dbd1e506e4604915efb71d661.png[/img]

• Implemented the Loading Screen on launching the game and joining a multiplayer session:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517539/20ae33d9babe96e0086c0dc1928be6adb7f5ef46.gif[/img]


• Implemented [b]Honor Loss[/b] game result rewarding players who perform well despite losing
• Implemented unique starting attributes for each character (e.g., Bastet starts with 2 speed, Roger with 2 bombs, etc.)
• Improved nicknames display in the Main Menu and in-game UI

[quote]💬 Join our [url=https://discord.gg/jbWgwDefnE]Discord[/url] to share feedback and stay updated!  
❤️ Don't forget to [b]Wishlist Bomberrage[/b] to support the game and get notified on launch![/quote]

notes.title: Bomberrage Goes Global - play in 30 Languages!
